scope: Native FreeCAD mesh assembly and persistent CAD articulation; no BRep creation, robot control or physical-operation claims
initial_pose: all six joint controls zero degrees
world_frame: official URDF base_link, without additional registration; translations converted metres to millimetres
limit_metadata: For each joint, JointParameters.<joint>_lower and <joint>_upper are App::PropertyAngle values in degrees from URDF limits
limit_scope: Evaluator checks metadata and makes only in-range edits. Native enforcement of out-of-range user edits is not assessed. No custom setter is required.
link_frames: One native App::Part named Link_<exact_URDF_link_name> for every URDF link, including fixed gripper_frame_link; getGlobalPlacement() gives world transform
visual_instances: One Mesh::Feature named Visual_<exact_URDF_link_name>_<zero_based_visual_index> for each URDF visual element, in file order. Preserve source mesh geometry scaled to millimetres and the visual origin transform relative to its link. Repeated assets remain distinct instances.
articulation: Editing an angle and recomputing updates the full appropriate descendant subtree and every visual instance. Fixed origins and visual offsets persist. Use native editable relationships that survive a fresh process reopening the FCStd without importing candidate Python code.
geometry_kind: Mesh geometry must remain explicitly identified as mesh. Do not replace detailed source geometry with proxy shapes or claim a faceted mesh is an exact BRep.
evaluation: Independent official-URDF transforms, component geometry/coverage, individual and combined joint edits, native limits metadata, fresh-process reopen and another edit. Collision-clearance certification is reported separately from articulation validity.
